sections.title: Updates
items: The developer can publish required or optional releases through GitHub Actions.
Clients can update now or opt into automatic optional updates.
Updates wait for an open sale to finish or be cleared, then restart the application.
Required updates prevent new sales once detected; an already-open sale may finish.
Patch notes are available offline through What's new at the bottom-left.

sections.title: Included platform features
items: Separate Developer and POS apps, tenant management, account roles, plans, modules and renewals.
Signed licensing allows up to 24 hours offline, never beyond paid expiry.
Local catalog, stock, cash checkout, manually verified GCash recording and cloud sale backup.

sections.title: Initial release limitations
items: Inventory is per-terminal; cloud sale backups are not multi-terminal stock synchronization.
Hardware printing, refunds, certified invoicing and automatic payment verification are not included.
